title: Keep the row's name in view

do.text: Put the column that names a row first and pin it (`columnPinning`), so it stays put while the rest scrolls sideways.

dont.text: Don't let the name scroll away: on a narrow screen people lose track of whose row they are reading.

do.text: Format amounts with their currency and align numbers to the end, so digits line up for comparing.

dont.text: Don't show raw numbers aligned to the start: ragged digits make the larger value hard to spot.
